headline: Appreciation of the Dominican peso against the dollar
summary: The Dominican peso gained 5.43% against the US dollar on Thursday, according to central bank data. The reference rate was 59.51 pesos for buying and 60.04 pesos for selling per dollar.
why: The Dominican Republic's peso is the national currency, and its central bank publishes a weighted-average reference rate from market trading. Currency moves affect import costs, dollar-denominated debt and returns for foreign investors.

impacts.name: Dominican peso
impacts.why: A stronger peso against the dollar lowers the local-currency cost of dollar-priced imports and dollar debt payments.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Central bank data reported a 5.43% appreciation of the peso against the dollar, based on a weighted-average market reference rate. The input does not give a specific cause for the move.
original_headline: Apreciación del peso dominicano frente al dólar
